title: Signature Weapon
description: Create your own unique, distinctive weapon. It starts with one-handed and inflicts 1d8 DMG. Choose one per row (or create a new one with the GM)

outcomes.text: **adaptable** (choose an extra range), **piercing**, **precise**, **sharp** (increase DMG size **one step**), **two-handed** (increase DMG to 1d12)

bullets: Alarming - it glows in the presence of one creature type
Bane - has **piercing** against one creature type
Destructive - inflicts max DMG against inanimate objects
Grappling - after inflicting DMG, you can pull a target closer to you
Pinning - after inflicting DMG on a creature your size or smaller, you can have it stay there and immobilize them
